pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YOU’RE VERY SMART, ASH. FAR TOO SMART TO NEVER BE MORE THAN BOSS TO A PACK OF PUNKS.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I DO WISH YOU’D PUT THAT RIGHT HAND OF YOURS TO WORK FOR ME.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: IS THAT A JOKE, OR HAVE YOU ACTUALLY GONE SENILE?

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YOU’VE CERTAINLY GOT TOO SMART A MOUTH, HAVEN’T YOU, ASH?

pages.speaker: UNKNOWN
pages.text: YOU USED TO CRY OVER EVERY ASSIGNMENT I GAVE YOU.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: BUT THERE'S SOMETHING YOU MUST NEVER FORGET.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: IT WAS I WHO TOOK YOU IN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ..I HEAR YOU'VE BEEN SPENDING A LOT LATELY.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: DID YOU FINALLY FIND A GIRL- FRIEND?

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: I HEARD YOU WERE WRESTLING WITH PORKCHOP MARVIN AGAIN.
